high_level_description: This image depicts a wide river scene with a bridge spanning across it. The sky is overcast, giving the scene a muted and somewhat somber mood. The water appears calm but slightly choppy, reflecting the cloudy sky above. In the foreground, two individuals are standing in the river, partially submerged up to their waists. They appear to be engaged in some activity, possibly related to fishing or cleaning the riverbed. One person is wearing a white shirt, while the other is dressed in darker clothing. Both are facing away from the camera, looking towards the far side of the river.
